title: Leftover makeover
brief: Turn last night's dinner into a tiffin nobody would recognise. Show the leftover and the lunch.

title: Millet month
brief: Build a full tiffin around a millet: ragi, jowar, bajra, foxtail or kodo.

title: Colour tiffin
brief: Three or more natural colours in one tin, no food dye. Holi month, so make it bright.

title: Twenty-minute tiffin
brief: From cold kitchen to sealed tin in 20 minutes. Tell us your timings.

title: Mango season
brief: Raw or ripe, sweet or savoury: a tiffin where mango earns its place.

title: No-cook summer box
brief: A complete, filling tiffin with no stove and no oven.

title: Monsoon comfort
brief: The tiffin you want when it has rained all morning.

title: Travel tiffin
brief: A tiffin that stays good on an eight-hour journey, in the spirit of thepla and puri-aloo.

title: Back-to-school box
brief: A child-approved school tiffin that comes home empty. Bonus points for picky-eater wins.

title: Festival snack box
brief: A festive tiffin for Navratri, Dussehra or Diwali week that is not just sweets.

title: Protein tiffin, vegetarian
brief: A vegetarian tiffin with a serious protein count. Show us where the protein comes from.

title: A tiffin for someone else
brief: Cook a tiffin for a neighbour, a new parent or a student far from home, and tell us who it was for.
